outcome.description: Execution outcome for the assigned agent task. Use COMPLETED when the requested analysis/review was delivered, even if the report finds critical/P0/release blockers. Use BLOCKED only when the agent could not complete the assigned task because required evidence, access, authorization, or another prerequisite was unavailable.

blockers.description: Execution blockers that prevented completion of the assigned agent task. Do not put product defects, release blockers, security findings, QA failures, or production-readiness issues here when the audit/review itself was completed. Use NONE when there is no execution blocker.

recommended_next.description: Recommended next workflow or engineering action after this completed analysis. Do not write BLOCKED merely because the product is not release-ready.
